verdict.rationale: Better Auth's docs say it hosts an official remote MCP server that any MCP-capable client (Cursor, Codex, Claude Code, Open Code) can connect to, so an agent can connect via a first-party MCP server. The separate MCP plugin, which makes your app an OAuth server for MCP clients, is a developer building block and is not credited here. Missing for 10: the server's scope is limited to documentation search, examples and setup help, with no tools for operating an auth instance; there is no detail on connection/setup or tool inventory; and there is no independent or hands-on corroboration that the server works.
